hook: Foreign Eritrean soldiers just crossed the northern border into Ethiopia, sparking an official UN complaint.

sections.voiceover: Foreign Eritrean soldiers just crossed the northern border into Ethiopia, sparking an official UN complaint.
b_roll: Border map of Ethiopia and Eritrea

sections.voiceover: Eritrean troops marched directly into the Tigray region as fierce fighting erupted. Residents inside Adigrat witnessed the armed columns moving south. Where did the UN Security Council letter go?
b_roll: Document view of United Nations headquarters

sections.voiceover: Ethiopia accused Eritrea of an all-out invasion of its northern Tigray region in a letter sent to the United Nations Security Council.
Government officials filed formal charges inside the UN Security Council chambers concerning Eritrea.
Watch the UN Security Council for the next diplomatic update.
